mapper.select: SELECT c.clubOwner_key, c.club_name, c.club_logo, c.club_region, c.club_status, TO_CHAR(c.club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD')AS club_created, c.club_content FROM club c JOIN clubJoin cj ON cj.clubOwner_key = c.clubOwner_key JOIN player p ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num WHERE cj.memberIdx = #{memberIdx} AND cj.clubJoin_result = 1 AND c.club_status = 1 AND p.leave_date IS NULL
